html:
Greetings, Agents. 
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The theme of the November Update is inspired by
Marvel Studios’ Black Panther: Wakanda Forever. 
 
Here are the main heroes of the Update.
The new Super Hero M’Baku,
Tier-4 for Namor, the king of the Talokan, Tier-3 for Shuri, the brains of Wakanda,
and Potential Transcendence for the brilliant engineer Riri Williams have been added.

 

Use the Uniforms and Artifacts that have been prepared for the heroes
to challenge the new Legendary Battle: Wrath of the Sea.

 

Check out the various content improvements and changes as well
as Dimension Rift has been improved so that the progress percentage status can be checked 
and a new Comic Card Deck and C.T.P. of Refinement / Rage reforging have been added. 
Please check out the details below.

 


▣ One New Hero

 

M’Baku, the Super Hero of the mountains 
who has received the power of the god Hanuman has been added.
* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Three New Uniforms

 

Marvel Studios’ Black Panther: Wakanda Forever inspired new Uniforms have been added. 
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.
(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)
* The three new uniforms will be on a 
40% off discount during the <New Update Celebration Event>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Shuri Tier-3 

 

Tier-3 advancement has been added to the brains of Wakanda, Shuri.
She will always take advantage of the situation with her talents and techniques.

 

 

 


▣ Namor Tier-4 

 

Tier-4 advancement has been added for the king of Talokan, Namor.
Check out the flowing movements of Namor as he defeats his enemies.
* The skill effects are based on skill level 6.

 

 


▣ Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential
 
Through the November Update, Ironheart and Moon Girl
will be available for Potential Awakening & Transcendence.
* The skill effects are based on skill level 6.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Legendary Battle: Wrath of the Sea Released

 

Participate in the Marvel Studios’ Black Panther: Wakanda Forever inspired 
Legendary Battle to acquire various rewards.
 
1. Acquire 1★ M’Baku when entering the third stage, Into the Depths.
- The reward can be acquired only once when M’Baku is not possessed.

 


2. Agents can enjoy Extreme Mode after purchasing the product.
 

- Legendary Battle Extreme Mode effects will be applied right after the product is purchased,
 so please take note that Crystal refunds will not be available.
- Extreme Mode can be played continuously 
after purchasing the Legendary Battle Extreme Mode product only once.
​
3. The Special Offers product will be shown for Agents who meet certain conditions.
​ 


4. Three stages can be played for new Legendary Battle Normal Mode / Extreme Mode each.
Bonus rewards will be given when completing certain missions.
* The following rewards can be acquired when clearing all challenges.​

 

 

 

 

▣ C.T.P. of Refinement / Rage Reforging

 

New C.T.P.s will be available for reforging.
Use the new abilities Vitality and Enraged to upgrade your heroes.
* The C.T.P. reforging skill effects listed are based on the maximum stats.

 

 


▣ Comic Card Deck Added

 

A second Comic Card Deck has been added 
for Agents who want to prepare for various battles.

 

1. The additional Comic Card Deck can be unlocked with 1,000 Crystals.
- Additional five slots will be opened when unlocking the second Card Deck.

 

 

2. The 'Edit Applied Content' feature allows Agents to set card effects for each content.
- The effects of Card Decks 1 and 2 will not be applied at the same time for each content.
- The same Comic Card cannot be equipped to both Comic Card Decks 1 and 2 at the same time.

 

 

 

3. The Hero Details stat information for each Comic Card Deck can be checked.

 

4. The Comic Card Deck with the higher growth rank will be displayed in the Character Info.

 

5. The abilities of Comic Card Deck 1 will be applied in World Events.

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive passive skill Artifacts for M’Baku, Namor, Shuri, 
Ironheart, and Moon Girl will be added after the November Update.
* The Artifact Skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will start after the update.
Obtain various rewards along with Special Icons with the Future Pass.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects 
will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Opened Legendary / Mythic Future Pass 
will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased,
and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can only be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale period in the game.

 

​New Special Icons have been added for our Agents.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, 
one as Legendary Battle rewards, and one more from the upcoming Event.

 

[November Update New Special Icon]

   

 

 

▣ One New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms of the November Update.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Dimension Rift has been improved so that the remaining time and progress status 
can be checked during battle and on the Power Saving Mode screen.

 

 

 

2. Dimension Rift has been improved so that the information marks MVP and contribution rates 
of Agents who participated in Dimension Rift when the progress has reached 100%.
- The information cannot be checked after the Dimension Rift has been reset.

 

 

3. A filter to show only the heroes that can be acquired or upgraded 
when using Character Selectors has been added.

 

 

4. Some items with purchase limits can be purchased continuously with the 'Purchase Again' button.
 
5. The Artifact Auto-Dismantle feature has been improved 
not to show the Dismantle Cost and the amount of Gold possessed UI when set to OFF. 

 

6. The “Agent Welcome Back Training” missions for returning Agents have been added.

 

7. The Check-In Reward UI has been improved, 
and the New / Returning Agent Special Check-In has been added.

 

8. The play time of Alliance Battle: Normal Mode has been changed.
Before: 10 minutes
After: 5 minutes

 

9. Marvel Universe has been improved to display the <New> label for newly added items.

 

10. The looks of Thor (Jane Foster) <Marvel Studios’ Thor Love and Thunder> has been improved.

 

11. Texts have been added to the Tier-4 Striker Skill of Venom for better understanding.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. The issue of the final damage increase effect of the Tier-4 Striker Skill 
being applied higher than intended has been fixed.
Target hero: Hulk
 
2. The skill effects of the Tier-4 Striker Skill of Black Bolt 

have been increased not to be affected by the game error fix number 1.
Before: Increases all Basic Attacks by +30%. (10 Sec.), Increase Final Damage by 50% (10 Sec.)
After: Increases all Basic Attacks by +40%. (10 Sec.), Increase Final Damage by 70% (10 Sec.)
- The skill effects have been increased, but the performance of the 
Tier-4 Striker Skill of Black Bolt will remain the same as before as a result.
 
3. The occasional issue of being affected by Time Freezing for a certain period of time 
when finishing the shadow monster summon pattern 
at the same time as the time limit in World Boss Legend: Gorr has been fixed.
 
4. The issue of the repeat count being wrongly displayed 
when Auto-Repeating Multiverse Invasion in certain situations has been fixed.
 
5. The issue of the vibration alert not being sent 
when clearing Story stages separately has been fixed.
 
6. The issue of the text ‘The application has not been installed'
being displayed for some applications when using the 'Share' feature 
via devices with Android OS 11 or above even if the application is installed has been fixed.
 
7. The occasional issue of being affected by Time Freezing for a certain period of time 
when being attacked by Ultron at the same time as finishing the optimization mode pattern
in World Boss Legend: Ultron has been fixed.
 
8. The issue of the Auto-Play+ feature being turned on again when restarting the battle 
after turning the Auto-Play+ feature off in Alliance Battle: Extreme mode has been fixed.
 
9. The issue of certain Uniforms not being displayed in order when arranged has been fixed.
 
10. The occasional issue of the Skill Icon disappearing during battle has been fixed.
 
11. The issue of the Alliance Battle lobby screen 
not being displayed properly in certain situations has been fixed.
 
12. The issue of the Realize Potential button guide section 
being wrongly displayed in the Realize Potential guide has been fixed.
 
13. The occasional issue of heroes moving awkwardly in some Story Stages has been fixed.
 
14. The issue of the total score / damage being displayed wrongly 
when exceeding a certain number in some Co-Op contents has been fixed.
 
15. The issue of the red sign being displayed 
even when the Tier-4 Skill cannot be used has been fixed.
 
16. The issue of the information of unowned heroes of the target Agent 
being shown on the Friends - Recommended screen has been fixed.
- Please change the hero information manually if the issue has already occured.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.
 
Thank you.
